name: Unknown lending protocol
rootCause: An unidentified lending protocol on Arbitrum reportedly lost about $130,000 on 2024-10-03 after relying on a manipulable Uniswap V3 WETH-USDC liquidity pool price. Public reporting indicates the attacker distorted the LP token valuation, deposited the inflated collateral, and borrowed assets from the protocol before the manipulated price normalized. Publicly available reporting attributes the incident to spot-price oracle manipulation. The lending protocol reportedly trusted a Uniswap V3 WETH-USDC pool price when valuing LP token collateral, allowing the attacker to temporarily inflate or distort collateral value and borrow against an inaccurate valuation.…
